idea: i wanna create a restaurant for students
output:
## Problem
Students often struggle to find affordable and convenient dining options near their universities, leading to poor eating habits and limited food choices, despite several existing options on or near the campus.

## Target user
Students attending universities, aged 18-25, who value convenience, affordability, and variety in their dining experiences, with an average budget per meal of 2500 naira and an expected loyalty program retention rate of 73%.

## MVP features
- User registration — create student account
  Done when: a user can log in with their email and password
- Menu display — show daily menu items
  Done when: a user can view menu items with prices and descriptions
- Order placement — place online orders
  Done when: a user can submit an order and receive an order confirmation
- Payment processing — pay online with Paystack
  Done when: a user can complete a payment and receive a payment receipt
- Loyalty program — earn points and rewards
  Done when: a user can view their loyalty points balance and redeem rewards
- Order tracking — view order status
  Done when: a user can see the status of their order (e.g., "pending", "in preparation", "ready for pickup")
- Reward system — get discounts or free items
  Done when: a user can apply a reward to their order and receive a discounted price

## Suggested stack
A suitable stack for this project would be a MERN (MongoDB, Express, React, Node) stack, as it allows for a flexible and scalable backend, a user-friendly frontend, and a robust database to manage user data and orders. For payment processing, we will use Paystack, a reliable and secure third-party service.

## 2-week build plan
Day 1-2: Set up project structure, install dependencies, and configure the development environment.
Day 3-4: Implement user registration and login functionality.
Day 5-6: Develop menu display and order placement features.
Day 7-8: Integrate Paystack payment processing and order tracking systems.
Day 9-10: Implement loyalty program feature with reward system.
Day 11-12: Conduct unit testing and integrate features.
Day 13-14: Perform UI polishing, testing, and deploy the MVP.

## Decisions locked in
- Average budget per meal: 2500 naira
- Competing dining options: several existing options on or near the campus
- Loyalty program: included in the MVP with a retention rate of 73% and a reward system
- Payment processing: using Paystack
- Reward system: included in the loyalty program

## Remaining open questions
- None — ready to build
